Chengdu成都

The lowest-cost large city with a real startup scene.

Registered address
¥4k–12k / year
Typical setup
3–6 weeks
Region
Western China
Best suited to
Software, games, design, education, tourism and consumer brands targeting western China; founders optimizing for quality of life and runway.

Chengdu has become the default answer for founders who want a Chinese company without Shanghai costs. The city has a genuine software and gaming industry, a large university population, and a local government that has invested heavily in attracting talent and startups.

The catch is market access. Chengdu is a good place to build and a harder place to sell nationally from, and the foreign professional-services ecosystem is thinner. Founders who need a bank, a lawyer and a Big Four accountant in the same afternoon will miss Shanghai.

What actually differs here?

Chengdu is a good place to be a small company and a difficult place to be a foreign company with a compliance problem. Local counsel matters more here, not less.

Office rents are a fraction of coastal cities; salaries are lower; the savings are real, but the pool of English-speaking senior staff is smaller.

Before you commit to an address here

The figures on this page are ranges. District practice decides whether a specific address will register, bank and pass inspection — and it changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district market regulator and the bank to confirm the address before you sign the lease, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Registration practice

How the paperwork actually goes in Chengdu

Registry speed, address rules and the district-level differences that decide whether a plan is realistic.

Registering

Registration is through the Sichuan provincial portal with district review. Chengdu High-tech Zone (高新区) and Tianfu New Area are the startup districts and offer the most generous incentives; Jinjiang and Wuhou are central and convenient for consumer businesses.

Banking

Account opening is slower than in Shenzhen and the branch may be less familiar with foreign-owned companies. Prepare the full document set, a clear business explanation and a Chinese-speaking staff member to attend the appointment.

Work permits

Work permits are processed by the municipal science and technology bureau. Chengdu is generally welcoming, but the salary threshold is lower than Beijing's and the permit still depends on a genuine employment relationship and a company tax record.

Address supply

¥4k–12k / year. Expect a lease, a property certificate and a utility bill in the company's name before a bank will look at the file.

Know before you commit

Three risks in this city

  • Assuming a Chengdu entity can serve customers nationwide without local registrations or tax filings.
  • Hiring senior staff who will not relocate, then managing a remote team across time zones.
  • Taking a subsidy whose conditions — headcount, local IP, tax residency — you cannot meet.

Best suited to

Software, games, design, education, tourism and consumer brands targeting western China; founders optimizing for quality of life and runway.
